label: Bible Study
prompt: For God sent not his Son into the world to _____ the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
verse: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
note: The verse right after John 3:16 — the mission was rescue, not condemnation.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I _____ God, that it shall be even as it was told me.
verse: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.
note: In a storm with 276 souls aboard, Paul's pep talk is simple: be of good cheer, for I believe God.

label: Sunday School
prompt: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did _____ Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
verse: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
note: On Easter morning two disciples raced to the tomb, and John's Gospel records that the other disciple won.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing: and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth: and none can _____ his hand, or say unto him, What doest thou?
verse: And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing: and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth: and none can stay his hand, or say unto him, What doest thou?
note: Nebuchadnezzar's confession after his season of madness in the fields: no one can hold back God's hand.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Righteousness _____ a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
verse: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
note: A civics lecture in one line: righteousness 'exalteth' a nation, but sin is a reproach to any people.
